parameters.content:
# CreatorLoop — YouTube Sync & Audience Intelligence


## This n8n workflow connects a public YouTube channel, syncs the latest videos, monitors recent comments every 15 minutes, and sends them to FastAPI for AI analysis.

## It handles video metadata, secure comment ingestion, semantic-search processing, reply recommendations, and unmet-demand detection for future content opportunities.

## **Flow:** YouTube → n8n → FastAPI + Gemini → PostgreSQL/pgvector → Replies & Content Opportunities

# CreatorLoop — Approved Reply Publishing

## This workflow securely publishes **creator-approved AI replies** to YouTube.

## It receives the approved reply from FastAPI, validates the comment ID and reply text, verifies the authenticated YouTube publishing account, posts the reply through the **YouTube Data API**, and returns the published reply ID back to CreatorLoop.

# FastAPI → n8n → YouTube OAuth → Publish Reply → Return Status
